notes.text: These verses are addressed to the Lord (you) about the king (he), celebrating the military success prayed for in Psalm 20. The psalm assumes that the king is faithful to the Lord; it is not intended to endorse sinful plans.
When the king (you) lives by the Davidic ideal, God takes hostility against the king as hostility against himself. Thus the godly king is the tool of God’s wrath.
As in 18:46, the Lord is exalted when he shows his power by making the faithful king successful.
